title: Sound Count · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Sound Count · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner chooses a number from one to five. The partner makes that many gentle taps without saying the number. The lead states the correct number of taps. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Sound Count, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead states the correct number of taps.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The lead states the correct number of taps.
